quarterly_data.signal: Cisco's 10-Q: as of April 25, 2026 inventory purchase commitments with contract manufacturers and suppliers were $16,033 million versus $7,599 million at the end of fiscal 2025 (up 111%), inventories were $4,708 million versus $3,164 million (up 49%), and inventory deposits and prepayments were $1,072 million versus $825 million. Cisco attributes the increase primarily to commitments related to manufacturing Cisco Silicon One and other products to meet demand from hyperscalers and other customers, and says that in the third quarter of fiscal 2026 it increased its purchase commitments with a certain supplier to help secure memory components.
quarterly_data.figure: inventory purchase commitments $16,033 million (+111%); inventories $4,708 million (+49%); inventory deposits and prepayments $1,072 million vs $825 million

quarterly_data.signal: Cisco's 10-Q: total remaining performance obligations were $43,462 million as of April 25, 2026, flat compared with $43,533 million at the end of fiscal 2025; product RPO increased 2% while services RPO decreased 3%.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $43,462 million vs $43,533 million (flat); product RPO +2%; services RPO -3%
